panels.general_description: Four stacked monitor rhythm-strip excerpts with printed event labels, each showing rapid irregular waveform.
panels.detailed_description: Four stacked rhythm-strip excerpts from a bedside monitor recall printout. Each strip has a printed header line reading "Arrhythmia Recall / Caliper" with a bed label, a calendar date and clock stamp and small rate and extrasystole-count fields; those stamps and fields are not transcribed. The event labels printed at the upper left of the four strips read "FIB V.", "FIB V.", "TACHYCARDIE" and "SALVE ESV". Each strip carries a lead label "II x2" and a "25mm/s" scale at the left, and small printed markers (P, V and "?" symbols) sit along the top of the tracings. The first strip begins with a few complexes and then runs into rapid, irregular, variable-amplitude oscillation; the other three strips show continuous rapid irregular large oscillation with no discernible baseline. Partly visible handwriting appears at the top right corner of the printout.

measured_quantities.visual_cue: Four stacked monitor strips with printed event labels

limitations: Header rate and extrasystole-count fields are not transcribed.

That box branches Yes to "ICD implantation" and No to "Outpatient telemetry monitoring demonstrating NSVT or sustained VT?".
